record.content: The official Forest Service Convict Lake hiking map depicts a continuous dotted hiking route around the lake. The retained south-shore trail reaches the road and cul-de-sac on the lake's east side; the mapped loop follows a road connection, returns to an east-side lakeshore trail, and then uses another road connection through the boat-ramp and trailhead-parking area to rejoin the retained north-shore trail. The map does not publish individual leg mileages or reusable line geometry for these three mixed-surface connections.
